svg.aria-label: Bodyweight Squat, Upright: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart. Reach your arms forward for balance.
svg.title: Bodyweight Squat, Upright: Stand with feet about shoulder-width apart. Reach your arms forward for balance.

svg.aria-label: Bodyweight Squat, Lower: Bend your hips and knees together, with your heels planted and knees following your toes.
svg.title: Bodyweight Squat, Lower: Bend your hips and knees together, with your heels planted and knees following your toes.

svg.aria-label: Bodyweight Squat, Bottom: Lower as far as you can control with your whole foot on the floor.
svg.title: Bodyweight Squat, Bottom: Lower as far as you can control with your whole foot on the floor.

svg.aria-label: Bodyweight Squat, Stand: Push through both feet to stand tall again.
svg.title: Bodyweight Squat, Stand: Push through both feet to stand tall again.
